יפלו למעשר שני [Hebrew] his propiores sunt,
מחצה למחצה יפלו [Hebrew] illis cedunt, si vero
למעשר שני זה הכלל [Hebrew] illis, ipsis etiam ce-
הולכין אחר הקרוב [Hebrew] dio, cedunt pullis

cimam secundam [inveniuntur] attribuuntur decimæ secundæ: si æqualiter ab hoc & illo distant, cedunt etiam decimæ secundæ. Hæc est generalis regula: (1) Erunt ad magis propinquum ad facilitandum, in medio verò ad aggravandum.
ב מעות שנמצאו [Hebrew] I I. Nummi qui
הבית חולין בירושלם [Hebrew] bus, semper decimæ

page.notes: Hebrew words are rendered as far as legible from the scan; the Hebrew letters in the first lines are faded and could not be read reliably, so exact vocalisation is uncertain. The Latin is set in two parallel columns with Hebrew on the left; the Hebrew columns are shown here only as far as the scan allowed. Nothing printed is omitted. Marks "s" are long s in the print and were kept as printed.
